questions.prompt: State the relative electrical charge of a proton.
State the relative electrical charge of a neutron.
State where most of the mass of an atom is found.
Name the three types of nuclear radiation emitted by radioactive nuclei (other than neutrons).
State what an alpha particle is made of.
questions.answer: Two neutrons and two protons (a helium nucleus).
